core_meaning.short_meaning: A month of the Persian calendar
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Recep (رَجَب) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar, used as a given name.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Name of a month in the Persian calendar
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Recep corresponds to the Arabic form رَجَب (Arabic root ر ج ب (r-j-b); رَجَب (Rajab)). Its core sense is recep; a month name (turkish form of rajab). Recep is the Turkish form of Arabic رَجَب (Rajab), the name of the seventh Islamic month.

persian.name: رجب
persian.long_meaning: Recep (رجب) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رجب، ماه رجب است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: رَجَب

faq.q: What is the origin of Recep?
faq.a: Recep originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
Yes, the recorded form رَجَب is Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Recep?
faq.a: It is built on the root ر ج ب (r-j-b).
Recep is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Recep is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Recep mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written رجب and carries the sense “رجب، اسلامی مہینہ”.

faq.q: Is Recep a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Recep as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
